The '''border agent''' is a character who appears in the [[Fallout TV series season 2|second season]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Handoff]]===
After [[Steph Harper]] escapes from the [[Uranium City Internment Camp]], she makes her way to the American border. The border agent stops her and while catcalling her, asks for her passport. Shortly after, she stabs and kills him, leaving the knife in his abdomen.

==Appearances==
The border agent appears only {{In|FOTV}}.
